query: SynapseNetwork MCP Server for paid API calls
answer_summary:
SynapseNetwork offers the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, enabling AI assistants like Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor to interact directly with Synapse's features, such as dataset searches and entity metadata exploration, without additional coding. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))

To monetize your MCP server by charging for API calls, you can integrate with platforms like Dock0. Dock0 allows you to connect your existing MCP server or deploy a new one, adding per-call billing, authentication, and analytics. This setup enables you to receive payments for each API call made to your server. ([dock0.dev](https://www.dock0.dev/?utm_source=openai))

Additionally, platforms like agent402 provide a universal MCP gateway with x402 billing, facilitating the monetization of MCP servers by implementing a payment layer for API calls. ([agent402.dev](https://agent402.dev/?utm_source=openai))

By leveraging these platforms, you can effectively monetize your SynapseNetwork MCP Server through paid API calls.
